newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 26-week T-bill auction for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 26-week T-bill auction for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of 26-week treasury bills on Wednesday, the central bank (NBS) said on Monday.
An NBS statement did not give any further details on the American-style auction.
Average yield in the last successful auction of 26-week treasury bills was 14.25 percent on May 21 when all of 73 million crown worth of bids were accepted.
The ministry does not set minimum or maximum limit price on bids in auctions of state securities, nor does it set amounts on offer.

Finance Ministry uses T-bills and state bonds as its main tolls to cover state budget deficit, which totalled 4.692 billion crowns in the first four months of this year, up from 3.450 billion crowns in the first quarter of 1997.
